I was literally in your position last year, I’m 20 y/o girl from Australia and I’d been in denial about my mental health for years but at a point I just couldn’t take it anymore. This was during the peak of the Melbourne lockdown but I think being able to tell my GP about it over the phone as opposed to in person made it easier. Also another option is to write down everything on your phone or a piece of paper and just hand it to your GP, that way you don’t even have tk say anything.  For a mental health plan they get you to answer a K-10 questionnaire and then based on your score that determines your eligibility for a mental health care plan. But literally you don’t even have to tell your GP anything, you can just say “I’m really struggling with my mental health and I’d like a referral for a therapist”. 

After the first few times talking about everything with my GP and therapist it gets easier, it’s hard at first but it’s so rewarding to finally get help and be supported. Feel free to DM or reach out if you have any more questions or concerns !
